# Copilot instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` at the repository root. It holds the sources of truth, domain rules, conventions and git workflow for this project, and it applies to every AI tool used here.

- Before product or spec work, read `PRODUCT.md`.
- Before building or changing UI, search `DESIGN.md` for the page or component you are touching, and match the Figma frame of the same name.
- Write everything in English, reuse existing components and patterns before creating new ones, and follow the backend, frontend and git rules in `AGENTS.md`.
